name: Corsair Peripheral V2 (OpenRGB port)
description: Per-LED lighting of Corsair peripherals on the V2 protocol: K55 RGB PRO, K57 RGB (wired), K60 RGB PRO family, K70 Core / RGB PRO / RGB TKL, K95 RGB PLATINUM XT, K100; Dark Core RGB SE / Pro SE, Harpoon and Ironclaw Wireless, Katar Pro, M55, M65 RGB Ultra, M75, Scimitar Elite RGB; MM700; and the devices OpenRGB knows behind Slipstream wireless receivers. Adapted from OpenRGB (GPL-2.0-or-later); untested on hardware. Software render mode while running, hardware render mode (the device's own lighting) at shutdown; no DPI, polling, profile or other non-lighting command. Protocol notes: docs/hardware/corsair-peripheral-v2.md.
